title: Fix production Postgres connection exhaustion
description: Shopify pushes are failing with EMAXCONN because Vercel serverless instances can open too many Supabase/Postgres clients. Reduce serverless pool usage and avoid startup DB work on every cold start.
close_reason: Reduced Vercel Postgres pool usage and skipped startup DB/Stripe jobs by default to prevent Supabase max client exhaustion.

title: Fix Stripe double-charge: dedupe customer by email in create-checkout
description: Users can end up with two parallel active Stripe subscriptions when they sign in with a different Clerk auth method (e.g. Google vs email/password) under the same email. The /api/subscription/create-checkout endpoint only checks the local DB by Clerk userId; if no row is found it creates a new Stripe checkout with no customer parameter, causing Stripe to auto-create a second customer + subscription. Fix: before creating the checkout, look up Stripe customers by email; if an active/trialing sub exists, recover it; if a customer exists without an active sub, pass it as the checkout customer. Also add idempotencyKey bucketed per minute to absorb double-clicks.
close_reason: dedupe by email + idempotencyKey shipped on branch fix/stripe-double-charge-dedupe (commit c03ac85), pending PR review

title: Add Shopify OAuth connect callback
description: Implement Shopify OAuth start/callback flow for SnapSync AI so merchants can grant write_products permissions without manually pasting Admin API tokens.
close_reason: Implemented Shopify OAuth start/callback flow, frontend redirect connect UX, env docs, and focused OAuth validation tests.

title: Fix product detail blank media images
description: Product detail media boxes can render labels/descriptions without image content. Make product detail image URLs cache-safe and add a proxy fallback for failed image loads.
close_reason: Made product detail image URLs cache-safe and added proxy fallback for failed image loads.

title: Add product media drag ordering
description: Product detail media should support drag-and-drop reordering and dropping an existing product image onto the thumbnail preview to make it the primary image.
close_reason: Implemented product detail drag-and-drop media ordering and thumbnail promotion.

title: Add webhook idempotency: dedupe Stripe events by event.id
description: server/webhookHandlers.ts does not track processed event.id values. Stripe retries webhooks on timeout/failure, which currently re-runs upsertSubscription for the same event. Today this is mostly safe (upsert keys on userId), but it's missing defense-in-depth. Add a processed_webhook_events(event_id PRIMARY KEY, processed_at) table and check event.id before handling. Filed as a follow-up to lis-o1u.
